title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Rental History and the Share of Excess Kept on Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage
content:
A renter who regularly rents from Ridgeline Tool Rental on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account keeps a smaller share of the excess on a disputed damage repair charge.

**Sharing rule.** How much of the excess the renter keeps depends on the renter's rental history on the card: a renter whose Ridgeline Consumer Credit account shows 3 or more tool rental purchases posted in the last 24 months keeps the first 500.00 dollars of the excess in full and 50 percent of the excess above 500.00 dollars, the two parts added; a renter whose account shows 1 or 2 such purchases keeps 75 percent of the whole excess; any other renter keeps the whole excess.

**Terms.** The excess is the protected repair cost above the protection limit of the agreement. Tool rental purchases are purchases posted to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit account whose purchase channel is tool rental; one falls in the last 24 months when it is dated fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the day the adjustment is booked. No share is rounded on its own; the adjustment is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Sharing table

| Tool rental purchases on the card in the last 24 months | Share of the excess the renter keeps |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the first 500.00 in full, plus 50 percent of the excess above 500.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 75 percent of the whole excess |
| none, or no Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | the whole excess |

## Worked figures (hypothetical excess of 3271.00)

| Tool rental purchases | Share kept |
|---|---|
| 4 | 500.00 plus 50 percent of 2771.00, that is 1885.50 |
| 2 | 75 percent of 3271.00, that is 2453.25 |
| 0 | 3271.00 |

With an excess of 400.00 and 3 or more purchases, the whole 400.00 falls in the first band and is kept in full.
